SUB Alto importer
=================

This importer is a special case of Mets/Alto. Here, most information is only stored in ALTO.xml files, so only the Pages are in alto format.
It was developed to handle OCR newspaper data in the format provided by the `Hamburg State Library (SUB)
<https://www.sub.uni-hamburg.de>`_.
